data.name: Name
data.close_when_satisfied: Close the valve when the room is warm

data_description.temperature_sensor: One or more sensors in the room, away from the radiator. Heating decisions use these.
data_description.sensor_mode: How several sensors make one room temperature. Stale or unavailable sensors are left out. Backup: the first sensor counts; the others stand in while it is stale.
data_description.relay: Optional. Switched on while the room heats, smart heating included.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Optional. Used by the regulation, like Versatile Thermostat. Ignored while an outdoor sensor is set for the whole house in the card's Options.
data_description.regulation: How far the TRV setpoint is raised to make up for the TRV sitting next to the radiator. Same settings as Versatile Thermostat.
data_description.hysteresis: Heating starts this much below the target and stops at the target. Ignored while a hysteresis is set for the whole house in the card's Options.
data_description.smart_heating: While the boiler heats for another room, this room also takes heat, up to this much above its target. It never turns the boiler on by itself. 0 = off. Ignored while smart heating is set for the whole house in the card's Options.
data_description.close_when_satisfied: Send the TRV its minimum setpoint while the room needs no heat.
data_description.stale_minutes: With no update for this long, the TRV regulates on its own sensor.

data_description.boiler_climate: While any room asks for heat, a quick veto is set on this zone; it is cancelled when no room asks.
data_description.boiler_status_sensor: Optional. Shown on the card, e.g. the zone's current special function.

abort.boiler_exists: The boiler is already set up. Change it under Configure.
